concept: deep violet-black synthwave arcade arena, electric cyan glow, hot magenta and amber game pieces
style_notes: dark outline 1px, no anti-aliasing, front-top light, 16-bit arcade presentation

assets.name: bg
assets.description: View from INSIDE a synthwave arcade arena: the paneled walls and the glowing grid floor together cover the ENTIRE image edge to edge, corner to corner — no visible backdrop outside the room, no border, completely opaque. Deep violet-black walls with faint electric-cyan grid lines, a hot-magenta horizon line where wall meets floor, very subtle dark vignette in the four corners. Empty arena: no bricks, no ball, no paddle, no icons, no text, no logos. Calm and low-contrast so bright foreground pieces stand out; wide composition, nothing important at the edges.

assets.name: brick-skin-a
assets.description: a single rectangular arcade brick surface filling the whole frame edge to edge, hot magenta with a bright pink top-left bevel and a dark plum bottom-right bevel, a couple of faint darker cracks, glossy cyan glint on the top edge

assets.name: brick-skin-b
assets.description: a single rectangular arcade brick surface filling the whole frame edge to edge, saturated violet purple with a light lavender top-left bevel and a dark indigo bottom-right bevel, small amber rivets in the corners

assets.name: paddle
assets.description: a sleek horizontal arcade paddle bar filling the whole frame, dark indigo base with a bright electric-cyan stripe glowing along the middle and white glints at the rounded ends
